pages.title: Shubhanshu Shukla flies to ISS on Axiom-4

facts.text: Launch: 25 June 2025, 12:01 PM IST — Falcon 9 (⚠ not Falcon Heavy), Crew Dragon, Launch Complex 39A, Kennedy Space Center, Florida
facts.head: News

facts.text: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla (IAF): pilot — ⚠ first Indian to reach the ISS; first Indian in space in 40 years (after Rakesh Sharma, Soyuz T-11, 1984)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Docking target: 26 June 2025, 4:30 PM IST after a 28-hour journey; stay up to 14 days
facts.head: News

facts.text: Mission type: private Axiom Space mission with NASA and SpaceX — ⚠ not ISRO/Roscosmos joint
facts.head: News

facts.text: Crew: Peggy Whitson; Role: Commander; Country: USA
facts.head: News

facts.text: Crew: Shubhanshu Shukla; Role: Pilot; Country: India
facts.head: News

facts.text: Crew: Sławosz Uznański-Wiśniewski; Role: Mission Specialist; Country: Poland
facts.head: News

facts.text: Crew: Tibor Kapu; Role: Mission Specialist; Country: Hungary
facts.head: News

facts.text: 60 studies from 31 countries
facts.head: Science

facts.text: India: 7 ISRO-selected microgravity experiments; 5 ISRO–NASA joint studies; 2 in-orbit STEM demos
facts.head: Science

facts.text: Delays: original date 29 May 2025; LOX leak, Zvezda module snag; quarantine from 25 May
facts.head: Science

facts.text: Commissioning: 1 July 2025 at Kaliningrad, Russia; built at Yantar Shipyard
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Last warship procured from a foreign source
facts.head: News

facts.text: Series: eighth Krivak/Talwar-class frigate from Russia in two decades
facts.head: News

facts.text: Also: two Triput-class frigates at Goa Shipyard Ltd with Russian design support
facts.head: News

facts.text: Fleet: Western Fleet — "Sword Arm" (Western Naval Command) — ⚠ not Eastern
facts.head: News

facts.text: Fleet total: 10 ships of similar capability across four classes
facts.head: News

facts.text: Spec: Length; Detail: 125 m
facts.head: News

facts.text: Spec: Displacement; Detail: 3,900 tonnes
facts.head: News

facts.text: Spec: Crew; Detail: over 250
facts.head: News

facts.text: Spec: Weapons; Detail: BrahMos cruise missiles
facts.head: News

facts.text: Spec: Indigenous content; Detail: 26%, over 33 Made-in-India systems
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Not the first BrahMos ship (INS Kolkata, Talwar-class had it)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Training: crew in St. Petersburg and Kaliningrad
facts.head: News

facts.text: CAR: Chimeric Antigen Receptor — patient's own T-cells (⚠ not B-cells) engineered to attack cancer
facts.head: Basics

facts.text: Steps: leukapheresis → genetic modification → expansion → infusion
facts.head: Basics

facts.text: Approved for blood cancers: ALL, Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma, Multiple Myeloma — ⚠ not yet solid tumours
facts.head: Basics

facts.text: Side effects: Cytokine Release Syndrome (CRS), ICANS (neurotoxicity)
facts.head: Basics

facts.text: Cost abroad: over ₹3–4 crore per patient
facts.head: Basics

facts.text: ICMR-funded trials at CMC Vellore — hospital-based manufacture
facts.head: India

facts.text: IIT Bombay + Tata Memorial Centre — India's first cost-effective platform 'InCART'
facts.head: India

facts.text: DBT supports Make-in-India CAR-T
facts.head: India

pages.title: AI and the news industry — copyright concerns

facts.text: Issue: LLMs trained on news content without consent or compensation
facts.head: News

facts.text: India: DPIIT formed a committee on copyright and AI
facts.head: News

facts.text: Precedents: Australia and Canada laws making tech giants pay publishers
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ "Fair use" does not mandate compensation — allows limited use without permission
facts.head: News
